typed_authority_disagreements.analysis: The negated premise precedes the only positive premise binding its variables. The untyped authority binds over the whole body and admits the rule. Python validation, the typed judgement (cc-side scopes a negation to the PRECEDING positive premises) and both evaluators are order-dependent: claim-workbench.shen capcov.inst refuses a negation that is not ground at check time, and the spec elaborator requires negated variables bound first. The permissive untyped verdict is not adopted. Resolution belongs in rule-authority.shen (out of this change's scope).
